A small yellow body that shows my face and speaks with my voice.

## Same me. Same memories.

One BoBe, one memory, one set of goals. A body is one more place to meet BoBe.

## Make your own.

Nothing is for sale. The body is a prototype — feel free to make your own with the ESP32 kit.
